lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice talking about weekend plans using a simple condition with om.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Casual colleague small talk during a fika or short break.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Talking about plans and adjusting them based on a condition.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk about possible weekend plans. The plan depends on the weather.

main_focus.name: first conditional with om
main_focus.description: Use om + present tense to describe a realistic condition and its result.
model_examples: Om det regnar, stannar jag hemma.
Om vädret blir bättre, tar vi en promenad.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use this structure naturally 2–3 times in the dialogue.

useful_chunks: Vad ska du göra i helgen?
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use most active words if they fit naturally, but prioritize a believable dialogue.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks about weekend plans.
dialogue_shape.middle: They discuss two possible plans and mention the weather condition.
dialogue_shape.ending: They reach a loose conclusion or say they will decide later.

target_complexity.repetition: some natural repetition of the target structure is good

focus: how the weather affects the plan
what they will probably decide later

sentence_focus: one sentence with stanna hemma or ta en promenad
one sentence combining plan and condition
